name: neptunedata
description: Neptune Data API The Amazon Neptune data API provides SDK support for more than 40 of Neptune's data operations, including data loading, query execution, data inquiry, and machine learning.

subcommands.name: cancel-gremlin-query
subcommands.description: Cancels a Gremlin query.

subcommands.name: cancel-loader-job
subcommands.description: Cancels a specified load job.

subcommands.name: cancel-ml-data-processing-job
subcommands.description: Cancels a Neptune ML data processing job.

subcommands.name: cancel-ml-model-training-job
subcommands.description: Cancels a Neptune ML model training job.

subcommands.name: cancel-ml-model-transform-job
subcommands.description: Cancels a specified model transform job.

subcommands.name: cancel-open-cypher-query
subcommands.description: Cancels a specified openCypher query.

subcommands.name: create-ml-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates a new Neptune ML inference endpoint that lets you query one specific model that the model-training process constructed.

subcommands.name: delete-ml-endpoint
subcommands.description: Cancels the creation of a Neptune ML inference endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-propertygraph-statistics
subcommands.description: Deletes statistics for Gremlin and openCypher (property graph) data.

subcommands.name: delete-sparql-statistics
subcommands.description: Deletes SPARQL statistics When invoking this operation in a Neptune cluster that has IAM authentication enabled, the IAM user or role making the request must have a policy attached that allows the neptune-db:DeleteStatistics IAM action in that cluster.

subcommands.name: execute-fast-reset
subcommands.description: The fast reset REST API lets you reset a Neptune graph quicky and easily, removing all of its data.

subcommands.name: execute-gremlin-explain-query
subcommands.description: Executes a Gremlin Explain query.

subcommands.name: execute-gremlin-profile-query
subcommands.description: Executes a Gremlin Profile query, which runs a specified traversal, collects various metrics about the run, and produces a profile report as output.

subcommands.name: execute-gremlin-query
subcommands.description: This commands executes a Gremlin query.

subcommands.name: execute-open-cypher-explain-query
subcommands.description: Executes an openCypher explain request.

subcommands.name: execute-open-cypher-query
subcommands.description: Executes an openCypher query.

subcommands.name: get-engine-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of the graph database on the host.

subcommands.name: get-gremlin-query-status
subcommands.description: Gets the status of a specified Gremlin query.

subcommands.name: get-loader-job-status
subcommands.description: Gets status information about a specified load job.

subcommands.name: get-ml-data-processing-job
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specified data processing job.

subcommands.name: get-ml-endpoint
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an inference endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-ml-model-training-job
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a Neptune ML model training job.

subcommands.name: get-ml-model-transform-job
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified model transform job.

subcommands.name: get-open-cypher-query-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of a specified openCypher query.

subcommands.name: get-propertygraph-statistics
subcommands.description: Gets property graph statistics (Gremlin and openCypher).

subcommands.name: get-propertygraph-stream
subcommands.description: Gets a stream for a property graph.

subcommands.name: get-propertygraph-summary
subcommands.description: Gets a graph summary for a property graph.

subcommands.name: get-rdf-graph-summary
subcommands.description: Gets a graph summary for an RDF graph.

subcommands.name: get-sparql-statistics
subcommands.description: Gets RDF statistics (SPARQL).

subcommands.name: get-sparql-stream
subcommands.description: Gets a stream for an RDF graph.

subcommands.name: list-gremlin-queries
subcommands.description: Lists active Gremlin queries.

subcommands.name: list-loader-jobs
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the loadIds for all active loader jobs.

subcommands.name: list-ml-data-processing-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Neptune ML data processing jobs.

subcommands.name: list-ml-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists existing inference endpoints.

subcommands.name: list-ml-model-training-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists Neptune ML model-training jobs.

subcommands.name: list-ml-model-transform-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of model transform job IDs.

subcommands.name: list-open-cypher-queries
subcommands.description: Lists active openCypher queries.

subcommands.name: manage-propertygraph-statistics
subcommands.description: Manages the generation and use of property graph statistics.

subcommands.name: manage-sparql-statistics
subcommands.description: Manages the generation and use of RDF graph statistics.

subcommands.name: start-loader-job
subcommands.description: Starts a Neptune bulk loader job to load data from an Amazon S3 bucket into a Neptune DB instance.

subcommands.name: start-ml-data-processing-job
subcommands.description: Creates a new Neptune ML data processing job for processing the graph data exported from Neptune for training.

subcommands.name: start-ml-model-training-job
subcommands.description: Creates a new Neptune ML model training job.

subcommands.name: start-ml-model-transform-job
subcommands.description: Creates a new model transform job.
